I hope Special Commissioner Meleph
stays stationed at Torigo Base for
a long time...

rows.label: tlk45320124_01_msg0002

while she's here.

rows.label: tlk45320124_01_msg0004

whatever happens, she'll
protect the peace in Gula.

rows.label: tlk45320124_01_msg0005

everyone's guardian...
